name: Abel And Cain
overview: The account of Abel and Cain reveals the profound consequences of faith and obedience before God. Abel, by faith, offered a more excellent sacrifice that testified to his righteousness, while Cain's actions led to the first recorded murder when he slew his brother out of jealousy and anger. This tragic event underscores the seriousness of sin and its repercussions, as seen in the ongoing remembrance of Abel's righteous blood throughout Scripture. Furthermore, God’s provision of Seth as a replacement for Abel highlights His redemptive plan amid human failure.
